name: Rodisar
description: Rodisar was a sapient reptilian species from the planet Rodis in the Outer Rim Territories. Rodisars were a primitive inhabitants and waged seasonal wars with one another. General Nilo was a member of this species that was kidnapped from his homeplanet by a Zygerrian slavers. He eventually ended up in the gladiatorial arena of Rattatak around 22 BBY.

data.name: Rodisar
data.distinctions: Long snout, broad paws and dragging tail
